For the same mug they paid $5 for, they wanted others to pay $10. This is the psychology of ownership, or the endowment effect.

specificFindings: The Tokyo-to-Lewiston question is the authors self-directed puzzle about far travel yet familiar-country company,not a judgement about all Japanese students or actual user experience.

Rationally puzzling but psychologically intelligible is a contrast of explanatory perspectives. Does replaces make sense; the vocabulary label is the exact contiguous source phrase make rational sense,not the initially rejected discontinuous make sense label.

Commiserate means shared sympathy and understanding,not identical objective personalities. Familiarity as powerful force and psychological teddy bear refer to comfort,not physical force or guaranteed optimal decisions.

House hunting introduces an example. The first reader question asks an initial rental location,and the next conditional asks an eventual purchase location. They do not establish that every reader has moved or purchased anything.

Minnesota move,one-year downtownSaintPaul rental and others UptownMinneapolis recommendation remain distinct. No current rental recommendation,unmentioned restaurant name or completed purchase is invented.

Japanese restaurant is an additional liked local amenity. ByOctober the author was looking for a condo,not already purchasing every option. The later Charlottesville small NorthDowntown house was bought immediately; ten-year crowding is a later stage,not initial homelessness or a large first house.

LoveItOrListIt couples already own houses needing major renovation. Hilary is the renovation designer; David is the agent offering homes in another neighbourhood. These are the books programme roles,not independently verified current casting.

Objectively speaking still appears in the authors account with typically and appear. The contrast is attractive alternatives yet the couples he watched retain their familiar neighbourhood; this is neither every episode ever produced nor a set of independent market appraisals.
Richard Thaler is the books endowment-effect attribution. Other named researchers and thinkers are not assigned his finding,and this does not assert he alone conducted all later research.

The mug transaction is explicitly Lets say hypothetical. First seller becomes possible buy-back buyer after a week; the previous buyer/current owner is asked whether to sell. No actual user payment,accepted offer or completed repurchase is reported.

However contrasts expected unchanged/lower used-object value with owners wanting more. Five paid and ten wanted are not guaranteed realised profit or a proven market-price doubling; the same object is held constant.
This names the ownership-related buying/selling valuation gap. Typically and most are retained rather than exact twofold responses by all participants or a universal sales rule.

House overestimation concerns value to owners relative to others. Owning/familiar/liking is the authors explanation of a tendency,not a professional appraisal of each house or proof physical size changed.
List it means put the house up for sale in the programme context. Familiarity and ownership help explain retaining it,not adding it to a learning list or an asserted pre-renovation-only chronology.
Draw is attraction in a comparison with variety,not sketch,lottery or sports tie. Often is not always.

The snack sentence describes planning one snack for each of three future days and a tendency toward variety. Named brands are examples,not purchases already completed or actual user preferences. Later actual-choice behaviour remains distinct.

Last two quotes were trimmed to exact target sentences after the planned-evidence guard rejected an unassigned later snack-reasoning candidate. No inflated coverage was published. All25 targets add25 IDs and all prior fingerprints remain unchanged.

All11 inherited English/Chinese parent pairs were read fully and checked against actual pages115-117,including the cross-page used-mug argument,author-versus-reader attribution,conditional history,programme roles,valuation-versus-transaction distinctions and complete translations. Unpublished distractors were refined to plausible location,role,timing and scope errors.
limitations: This is a batch of ongoing whole-book work, not all gaps completed.
